description_en: Diagnoses and recovers cloud phone matrix instances. This operation clears the system log files of an instance to prevent the instance from becoming unrecoverable due to a full disk
description_zh: 云手机矩阵实例诊断恢复，目前仅可以清理实例的系统日志文件，避免磁盘打满之后实例异常无法恢复
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic instance-healer --instance-id-list cpn-42do7k000000-001 --timeout 30 --strategy Clean --region cn-hangzhou
name: InstanceHealer

parameters.help_en: The timeout period in seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 30
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The policy type. The only supported value is Clean
parameters.help_zh: 策略类型，目前仅支持清理系统日志文件
parameters.name: strategy
